name: hoja
description: Trebol's TaskManage (acceptance questions + evidence-validated completion), its Swarm task-enforcement hooks and Hoja mode (automatic TaskManage → Hoja issue publication), plus the hosted Hoja API tools — ported 1:1 to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-checked tasks, a task gate and Hoja issue sync
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex Trebol's TaskManage: every task carries acceptance questions and can only be completed with evidence that resolves to a real file or a real tool result from this session. A task-enforcement gate blocks mutating tools until a task is focused, and Hoja mode publishes each coarse task as a Hoja issue and keeps it current.
defaultPrompt: Plan this change as a TaskManage task with acceptance questions, then do it.
